items.name: parse-form-data
items.title: parseRequestBody + safeParseRequestBody + parseSearchParams
items.description: Server-side Zod validators for route handlers. Returns typed data or a 422 NextResponse with RHF-shaped field errors. Use the same Zod schema on the client form for one source of truth.

items.name: field
items.title: Field (one-row form field)
items.description: Single-component wrapper that handles FormField + FormItem + FormLabel + FormControl + FormDescription + FormMessage scaffolding for any text/email/number input or textarea. Pulls `control` from useFormContext so consumers don't pass it.

items.name: form-combobox
items.title: FormCombobox (async searchable select)
items.description: Searchable combobox bound to RHF. Supports static options OR an async loader keyed by query. Stores the selected value in form state; shows the label in the trigger. Replaces plain <select> for any dropdown with >5 options.

items.name: form-date-picker
items.title: FormDatePicker
items.description: Calendar-in-popover date picker bound to RHF. Stores a Date in form state. Replaces native <input type="date"> (terrible cross-browser UX). Configurable date format + fromDate/toDate bounds.

items.name: use-unsaved-changes
items.title: useUnsavedChanges
items.description: Warns the user before navigating away when a form is dirty. Two protection layers: beforeunload (refresh/close) + anchor click capture (internal Next.js links). Lets meta/ctrl-click pass through for new-tab opens.

items.name: form-autosave
items.title: useFormAutosave + FormAutosaveIndicator
items.description: Debounced auto-save for React Hook Form. Watches values, waits for inactivity, fires save (only when valid + dirty). Plus a three-state status indicator (idle / saving / saved with checkmark / error).
